classification: LOCAL STAGE B MODEL AND IMAGE IDENTITY BINDING / NOT SCIENTIFIC ADMISSION
purpose: Bind the exact instruction-tuned model artifacts and the additive local overlay image built for Stage B, so the image is reproducible and the model identity is canonical. Acquiring and baking a model creates no detection, steering, scientific, product, licensing, or disclosure claim.
why_a_second_model: EleutherAI/pythia-160m is a base model and does not reliably follow instructions. Stage B requires a model that follows instructions so that a joined controller-to-worker run exercises a realistic request. This binding adds such a model; it does not replace or retire the pinned pythia-160m binding.

model.acquisition_note: huggingface_hub snapshot_download returned success after fetching only one of seven files. Per-file size verification caught the silent partial failure. Every file listed here was independently size-checked and hashed after download, and re-verified inside the image at build time.

architecture_observed.source: config.json as loaded by transformers on the host

instruction_following_check.prompt: Reply with exactly one word: what color is a clear daytime sky?
instruction_following_check.meaning: CHAT TEMPLATE RENDERS AND THE MODEL OBEYS A ONE-WORD CONSTRAINT
instruction_following_check.not_meaning: NO DETECTION, STEERING, SAFETY, OR CAPABILITY CLAIM

in_image_verification.mechanism: The overlay build hashes all seven staged files inside the image and exits non-zero on any size or digest mismatch.

additive_guarantees: The pinned pythia-160m cache is present and unmodified.
No operating system, Python, CUDA, or application dependency was rebuilt or reacquired.
No pythia constant in app/runtime/model_loader.py was altered.

known_gaps.worker_cannot_serve_this_model_yet: app/runtime/model_loader.py pins pythia identity in LoadedModel.is_real, _validated_resolved_revision, and _validated_model_artifacts. The weights are present in the image but no loader path selects them. WIRED IS NOT WORKING.
known_gaps.probe_pipeline_paths_differ: Worker probe/layer walking targets gpt_neox.layers with mlp_intermediate width 3072. Qwen2.5-0.5B exposes model.layers with mlp width 4864 via mlp.down_proj.
known_gaps.stage27f_covers_do_not_transfer: The retained Stage 27F calibrated cover coordinates are pythia-specific and are NOT valid coordinates for this model.
known_gaps.no_joined_run: No Stage B joined controller-to-worker run has executed against this image.
known_gaps.no_evidence_packet: No Evidence Packet v2 has been created.
